text:
Mina: Heads-up — repro for weird token-splay at ~8200 tokens on the new 13B-int4 bringup when deferred KV sync is enabled. Reproducer and minimal logs below.

Mina: repro command I ran (dockerized runner):
```bash
./run_inference --model magnet-13b-int4 --seq_len 8600 --deferred-kv-sync=true --batch 1 
  --prompt-file tests/long_repro.txt --seed 42
```

Mina: Short log excerpt (collapsed):
```
[2026-03-21T09:12:03Z] prefill: tokens=4096
[2026-03-21T09:12:04Z] prefill: tokens=8192
[2026-03-21T09:12:05Z] inflight-merge: kv-index-range [0..8191]
[2026-03-21T09:12:05Z] emit: token 8192 -> "the" (expected " and")
[2026-03-21T09:12:05Z] mismatch-detected: kv-sync-lag 1 cycle
```

Dave: I can repro locally w/ the same flags. Looks like a one-token drift at the boundary where we switch from prefill-stream to inflight append.

Lucy: Bisecting now — preliminary indicates introduced around runtime change 2026-02-14 (kvcache: defer-sync handshake). Could be the handshake delay + int4 packing alignment.

Raj: Quick idea — does forcing a synchronous KV flush before switching to inflight fix it? If so it's probably a visibility ordering problem rather than quantization math.

Mina: I tried that — adding `kvcache.force_sync_before_inflight = true` removes the repro on my run. So that points at ordering. But we shouldn't need that hack.

Dave: Nice. I did a small instrumented run with sequence numbers on KV writes; observed one write batch getting delayed and applied after the inflight merge. So inflight read gets stale keys for 1 cycle.

Mina: Repro appears only when:
- deferred-kv-sync=true
- quant=int4 prefilling modes (compact packing)
- seq_len > 8000
If you reduce seq_len to 6000 repro disappears.

Lucy: I pushed a small patch that bumps the handshake priority (will paste PR link once CI finishes). It serializes the final prefill commit before letting inflight readers proceed.

perf-bot: build/4829 finished — tests: 312/312 passed, e2e-longctx flaky=1 (known flaky test flagged)

Raj: Can we add a unit test that simulates delayed ack from kvcache and asserts no token divergence? Prefer a deterministic fake kvcache in test harness.

Dave: Agreed. I'll add a deterministic kvcache shim and a regression test that runs a short but synthetic 8200-token prefilling sequence.

Mina: Also let's add a fuzz run in CI that toggles deferred-kv-sync on/off and runs a set of long prompts (we already have some corpora) to catch any remaining edgecases.

Sara: I'll open an INF ticket for rollout gating and note which Dedicated customers we should notify if we roll this out without the fix.

Dave: Opening PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/879 — includes test + fix.

Mina: Thanks — assigning follow-up to me + dave for verification on quantized models and on CPU emulation. Will run a compare vs non-deferred baseline and post token-level diffs.

Lucy: Good triage. Also we should check interactions with prefix-eviction (rare) — could amplify the race.

Mina: Logged: INF-3412. Next steps: land handshake-patch, run CI fuzz, run Dedicated canary.

Dave: I'll slam a small release candidate to staging once CI is green.

Mina: Awesome — keeping this thread for quick notes, will post final verification matrix here. :thumbsup:
